mapper.sql: select profile_id, user_id, real_name, dept_id, dept_name, job_level, bank_name, bank_account, phone, email, contact_address, avatar_url, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from biz_emp_profile
mapper.select:
select p.profile_id, u.user_id, ifnull(nullif(p.real_name, ''), u.nick_name) as real_name, ifnull(p.dept_id, u.dept_id) as dept_id, ifnull(nullif(p.dept_name, ''), d.dept_name) as dept_name, ifnull(nullif(p.job_level, ''), '1') as job_level, p.bank_name, p.bank_account, ifnull(nullif(p.phone, ''), u.phonenumber) as phone, ifnull(nullif(p.email, ''), u.email) as email, p.contact_address, ifnull(nullif(p.avatar_url, ''), u.avatar) as avatar_url, ifnull(p.status, u.status) as status, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join biz_emp_profile p on p.user_id = u.user_id
u.del_flag = '0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id where ur.user_id = u.user_id and r.role_key = 'employee' and r.del_flag = '0' ) and u.user_id = #{userId}
and (p.real_name like concat('%', #{realName}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{realName}, '%') or u.user_name like concat('%', #{realName}, '%'))
and (p.dept_name like concat('%', #{deptName}, '%') or d.dept_name like concat('%', #{deptName}, '%'))
and (p.phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%') or u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{phone}, '%'))
and ifnull(nullif(p.job_level, ''), '1') = #{jobLevel} and ifnull(p.status, u.status) = #{status}
order by ifnull(p.profile_id, 0) desc, u.user_id desc
